site.heroTitle: A NEW YEAR. A NEW OPERATION.
site.heroText: Welcome to The Intelligence — a student newspaper designed to keep the whole school informed, involved and curious about what is happening around campus.

clubs.title: Basketball Club

riddle.title: Riddle of the Week
riddle.question: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind. What am I?

entries.clue: Music: The structure or arrangement of a musical work.
Citizenship: A system where people have a voice in government.
Maths: A statement showing two expressions are equal.
Science: The process plants use to make food using light.
Computing: A step-by-step method for solving a problem.
Geography: A community of organisms and their environment.
History: A major change in government or society.
Physics: The quantity of motion an object has.
English: A system of communication using words.
Art: The technique used to show depth and distance.

puzzles.title: The Timetable Mystery
puzzles.question: Maya, Noah and Zara each chose a different club: Art, Coding or Drama. Maya did not choose Art. Noah chose neither Drama nor Art. Who chose Drama?
